headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 19, 2026**
article:
The Cleveland Guardians secured a crucial 8-2 victory over the Detroit Tigers, led by José Ramírez's impressive performance at the plate. Ramírez hit a home run and collected 3 hits, 1 HR, and 3 RBI in 4 at-bats.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, affecting their teams' lineups. Jordan Beck, the Colorado Rockies' left fielder, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. Other notable players on the injured list include Ben Casparius of the Los Angeles Dodgers, Corey Seager of the Texas Rangers, and Jose Altuve of the Houston Astros.

The Los Angeles Dodgers have acquired left-handed pitcher Eric Lauer in a trade with the Toronto Blue Jays. Additionally, the Chicago White Sox acquired Junior Perez from the Athletics in exchange for left-handed pitcher Jackson Nove. The Athletics also traded Kyle Robinson to the Pittsburgh Pirates for second baseman Alika Williams and Eduarniel Núñez to the Baltimore Orioles for cash.

top_news.title: **Guardians Take Down Tigers 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured an 8-2 victory over the Detroit Tigers, led by José Ramírez's impressive performance at the plate. Ramírez hit a home run (8) on a fly ball to left field and collected 3 hits, 1 HR, and 3 RBI in 4 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Rays Rout Orioles 16-6**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing a 16-6 victory. Junior Caminero led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall Short in Philly**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds dropped a 4-5 decision to the Philadelphia Phillies, with Bryson Stott leading the Phillies' offense. Stott hit a go-ahead home run in the game, driving in two runs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Rout Braves 12-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Atlanta Braves, securing a 12-0 victory behind a strong performance from Max Meyer. Javier Sanoja led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Place Jordan Beck on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies left fielder Jordan Beck has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. The injury occurred on May 18, 2026.

top_news.title: **Lauer Joins Dodgers Roster**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers have acquired left-handed pitcher Eric Lauer in a trade. The Toronto Blue Jays traded Lauer to the Dodgers for cash.
